Apple harvest, storage, cost and profit

By Gafar Laiya, Gujarat Bio Organics · Updated 2026-11-25

Delicious apples are harvested 130–145 days after full bloom (Gala 110–120 days), judged by a starch-iodine reading of 2.5–3.5 on a 1–6 scale for controlled-atmosphere storage (4–5 for fresh sale) and firmness of 16–18 lb per square inch (NHB). Traditional orchards yield 6–11 t/ha; M.9 high-density orchards 30–45 t/ha or more by year 5, with 75–85% grade-A fruit (ICAR-CITH).

Harvest and grading

GradeFruit diameter
Extra largeOver 80 mm
Large75–80 mm
Medium70–75 mm
Small65–70 mm
Extra smallBelow 65 mm

Only clean fruit above 70 mm wins strong prices against 544,000–600,000 tonnes of imported apples a year (USDA FAS 2024). Nearly 30% of Himachal's harvest is lost or downgraded after picking (NITI Aayog 2026), so careful picking, grading and cold chain pay directly.

Storage

Controlled-atmosphere (CA) storage at 0–1°C, 90–95% humidity, 1.5–2.0% oxygen and 1.5–2.0% carbon dioxide keeps apples for 6–9 months (NHB). Low-chill apples such as HRMN-99 keep only 10–12 days and should be sold fresh.

Cost and returns

Orchard typeInvestment / costYield
Traditional seedlingAbout Rs 1.2–1.8 lakh per hectare per year to maintain (pesticides alone Rs 97,360–1,09,870/ha in poorly scheduled Kashmir orchards)6–11 t/ha (2.5–4.5 t/acre)
M.9 high density (3,333 trees/ha)About Rs 35–48 lakh per hectare in year one (Rs 14–19.5 lakh per acre) for plants, trellis, drip and anti-hail net; 50% state / MIDH subsidy available for high-density planting30–45+ t/ha (12–18+ t/acre) by year 5, 75–85% grade A

Sources: ICAR-CITH, SKUAST-K survey (Nov 2026). Prices vary sharply by year, grade and market.

Apple price and rate today

Check today's apple rates on the government's Agmarknet and eNAM portals. Key markets: Azadpur (Delhi), Sopore, Parwanoo and Solan.

Questions farmers ask

When is apple harvested in India?

Gala in July–August (110–120 days after full bloom); Delicious 130–145 days after full bloom, mostly August–October depending on altitude.

What is apple yield per acre?

Traditional orchards 2.5–4.5 t per acre; M.9 high-density orchards 12–18 t per acre and more by year 5.

What is the cost of a high-density apple orchard?

About Rs 35–48 lakh per hectare (Rs 14–19.5 lakh per acre) in year one, with 50% state or MIDH subsidy available for high-density planting.

How long can apples be stored?

6–9 months in CA storage at 0–1°C, 90–95% humidity and 1.5–2% oxygen and carbon dioxide.
